question: The cost price of an article is ₹2,250, which is 25% below the marked price. If the article is sold at a 15% discount, what profit percent is made on the transaction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let the marked price be Rs. 100a

Then, Cost price = 100a × 75%

Cost price = 75a

CP over MP = 100 - d\% over 100+p\%

75a over 100a = 100-15 over 100+p\%

3 over 4 = 85 over 100+p\%

100+p% = 340/3

p% = 340/3 - 100

p% = 40/3 

p% = 13.33

∴ The profit is 13.33%

**Hence, the correct answer is 13.33%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The cost price of an article is ₹2,250, which is 25% below the marked price. If t

The article is sold at a 15% discount

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Marked price (100 - Discount)%

Profit% = (Profit/Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Marked price - Marked price × 25% = 2250

⇒ 0.75Marked price = 2250

⇒ Marked price = 2250/0.75

⇒ Marked price = 3000

So, selling price = 3000 - 3000 × 15%

⇒ 3000 - 450

⇒ 2550

Profit = 2550 - 2250

⇒ 300

Profit % = (300/2250) × 100

⇒ 13.33%

**∴ 13.33% profit is made on the transaction.**
